question: In the genuine limit-only nested families, can one all-equal call per dead depth carry every living state's need, and can those calls lie on one ray?

definitions.families: LIMIT-ONLY's 1,341 bottomless-limit-only records; genuine under the usual limit (pass-through knot added).
definitions.queries: single and single ray, exact SAT, depths T..T+2 of the depth-T+3 part with G at the bottom.

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 b72f76a655636af6c5b10b54dc5bead6aea2439e2b4a55f43eb3ffdaf756bf8b) beside this file; SHORT-DESC dlang.py; LIMIT-ONLY's sample records; pysat; numpy.
public_inputs.run: census.py --run W 16 for W in 0-15, then --summary, from the repository root; output artifacts/LIMIT-STATE-20261112-001A/LIMIT-STATE-20261112-001A-E001_limit_states/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing families, queries, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Shares of branching genuine families with a single witness per depth and with a single ray.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Chains (settled by the lemma); the lemma gate.
validation_gate: Lemma gate at every dead depth read; finite parts alive; genuine count 894.

predictions.P1: single share >= 0.8 among branching genuine families
predictions.P2: single ray share >= 0.5 among branching genuine families

stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
